mapper.select:
SELECT a.id, a.user_id, a.chapter_id, a.selected_text, a.content, a.type, a.like_count, a.comment_count, a.created_at, u.nickname AS user_nickname, c.title AS chapter_title, n.title AS novel_title FROM annotation a LEFT JOIN user u ON a.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN chapter c ON a.chapter_id = c.id LEFT JOIN novel n ON c.novel_id = n.id
AND (a.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.selected_text LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND a.type = #{type}
ORDER BY a.created_at DESC
